_comment: Prediction model (PLAN §6, Phase 4). Baseline = deterministic blend of base rate, momentum and 1-month mean reversion over verified month-end closes (src/quant/baseline.mjs). range_k is FROZEN from the walk-forward backtest (npm run backtest, 2024-01..2026-09 baseline-only, coverage target 60-76%); changing any value here changes baseline code_version semantics and needs a re-run of the backtest. Consensus = confidence-weighted analyzer views anchored on the baseline (src/quant/consensus.mjs).

baseline.range_k_frozen_at: 2026-10-31: npm run backtest -- --calibrate over target months 2024-01..2026-09 (96 baseline rows, GOOGL/AMZN/AAPL): k=1.10 -> lo-hi coverage 67.7% (k=1.00 gave 60.4%). In-sample choice; re-check as live outcomes are scored.
